edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff the Settlement Amount, to be agreed by the parties, within ten business days after both parties sign this Agreement, by wire transfer to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff.

2. RELEASE. Upon receipt of the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims arising out of the matters described in the pleadings, whether known or unknown, through the date of this Agreement. This release does not cover obligations under this Agreement or claims arising after its execution.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures to their legal, tax, and financial advisers who are bound to maintain confidentiality; as required by law, regulation, or court order; or as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement.

receiver.message_back: We can agree to the revised release and confidentiality language, subject to final review. Please confirm your client’s proposed Settlement Amount; we propose payment within five business days of signing, with the release effective only upon receipt of cleared funds.

delivered.body: Confidential Settlement Agreement RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve all claims. 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff the Settlement Amount set out below. 2. RELEASE. Upon payment, Plaintiff releases all claims against Defendant. 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement are strictly confidential. 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability.
